system.unexpected: Something unexpected happened on our side. Try again; if it keeps failing, share the reference below with your administrator.
system.not_found: This item no longer exists or was moved.
system.bad_request: The request was not valid. Refresh the page and try again.
system.internal: The server could not complete this request. Try again in a moment.
system.database_unavailable: The database is unreachable. Canopy will recover as soon as it is back.
system.database_not_configured: The database connection is not configured. Ask your administrator to set CANOPY_DATABASE_URL.
system.encryption_key_missing: Secret storage is not configured. Ask your administrator to set CANOPY_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
system.encryption_key_invalid: The encryption key is invalid. It must be 32 random bytes encoded in base64.
system.secret_undecryptable: A stored secret could not be read. It may have been encrypted with a key that is no longer configured.
system.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait {retryAfter, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.
system.engine_unavailable: The file engine is unreachable. Try again in a moment.
system.engine_key_missing: The file engine is not configured. Ask your administrator to set the engine keys.
system.maintenance: Canopy is under maintenance. Try again later.

settings.invalid_value: The value for “{key}” is not valid.
settings.locked_by_env: “{key}” is set by the {env} environment variable and cannot be changed here.
settings.local_only: “{key}” can only be changed from the local network.

auth.setup_already_done: Canopy is already set up. Sign in with an existing account.
auth.setup_not_local: The first administrator can only be created from the local network.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.password_breached: This password appears in a public data breach. Choose another one.
auth.invalid_code: This code is not valid. Check your app's clock and try again.
auth.second_factor_expired: This sign-in took too long. Start again.
auth.cannot_revoke_current: Use “Sign out” in the account menu to end this session.
auth.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an administrator for access.
auth.ip_blocked: Too many failed attempts from your network. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.two_factor_required: One of your groups requires two-factor authentication, so it cannot be turned off.
auth.engine_token_missing: Your session could not be passed to the file engine. Reload the page.
auth.engine_token_invalid: Your session expired for the file engine. Reload the page.
auth.link_invalid: This link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
auth.signed_out: Your session ended. Sign in again.

users.last_admin: Canopy needs at least one active administrator. Give another account the Admin role first.
users.not_on_self: Manage your own account from the Account page.

access.built_in_role: Built-in roles can be edited but not deleted.

files.forbidden: You don't have access to this folder.
files.not_found: This item no longer exists or was moved.
files.not_a_directory: This is a file, not a folder.
files.exists: Something with this name already exists here.
files.invalid_name: This name is not allowed. Avoid slashes and keep it under 255 characters.
files.into_itself: A folder cannot be copied or moved into itself.
files.same_location: These items are already in this folder.
files.duplicate_names: Two selected items have the same name; they cannot go into the same folder.
files.no_space: There is not enough free space at the destination.
files.verify_failed: A copied file did not match the original, so the source was kept.

mail.not_configured: Email is not configured. Set up SMTP in Administration › Email.
mail.auth_failed: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
mail.connection_failed: Canopy could not reach the SMTP server. Check the host, port and encryption.
mail.invalid_recipient: The SMTP server refused the recipient address.
mail.tls_failed: The secure connection to the SMTP server failed. Try another encryption mode.
mail.send_failed: The email could not be sent.

jobs.too_many: You already have too many operations in progress. Wait for one to finish.
jobs.interrupted: The operation was interrupted because the file engine restarted.
